title: Self-deploying Autopilot without a progress-tracking Enrollment Status Page

messages.businessImpact: Self-deploying Autopilot finishes to a desktop with no held Enrollment Status Page, so a device can look ready while required apps and policies never arrived.
remediation: Assign an Enrollment Status Page that shows progress and waits for the day-one apps, and target the same self-deploying population.
messages.cannotSee: Does not prove the ESP and the Autopilot profile reach the same devices; it only asks whether any progress-tracking ESP is assigned at all. White glove and pre-provisioning flags beyond IsSelfDeploying are not on the fact model. The console blocking toggle remains unread; see ENR-003 cannotSee.
